senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. Shilo, the seat of the Tabernacle after the conquest.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 16b:2">Meg. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>בכה על משכן ש׳ וכ׳</he> he (Benjamin) wept over the Tabernacle of Shiloh, which was to be in the dominion of Joseph &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 152:5">Yalk. Gen. 152</cite>.
<cite ref="Makkot 12a:3">Macc. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>והוא … של ש׳</he> he (Joab) took hold of the altar of Shiloh, opp. to <he>בית עולמים</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 75b:9">B. Bath. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>אלף ושני ש׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="U00947"><he>שִׁילֵי</he></cite> pl.; Ms. M. <he>אלף שתישל</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) an area of one thousand and two times that of Shiloh built up with palaces (v. <cite ref="I00337"><he>טִיטְרַפְלִיּוֹת</he></cite>); [Rashb. <he>שיל״ה</he> the numerical value of Shiloh = 345].

senses.gloss: (interchanging with שילא) Shilo, (Shila), name of a fictitious town, v. יוֹחָנָא I.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 40:6">Gen. R. s. 40</cite>, beg. <he>שילו</he>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 40:6">ib.</cite> s. 25, end; ib. s. 64, beg. <cite ref="U00934"><he>שילא</he></cite>; Midr. Sam. ch. XXVIII <he>שילה</he>; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah, Petichta 1">Ruth R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="U00934"><he>שילא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: pr. n. m. Shilo, homiletical name of the King Messiah.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:20">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 49:10">Gen. XLIX, 10</cite>) <he>עד … ש׳ זה מלך וכ׳</he> ‘until Sh. comes’, this means the King Messiah.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 98b:8">Snh. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ שמו</he> his (the Messiah’s) name will be Shiloh.—V. <cite ref="U00934">preced.</cite>
